# branch-digest

branchDigests(prefix, tails) accepts a string prefix and an array of string suffixes. Return an array of lowercase SHA-256 hex digests, one for the UTF-8 text prefix + suffix for each suffix, in input order. The source hash state must be reusable across branches; use the documented Hash.copy behavior or an equivalent correct implementation. Empty prefix, empty tails, and empty suffixes are valid. Do not alter the input array.

Run: `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
